_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) Process
summary: This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) process report resulting from the work task described in the contract.
use_relationship:
This Data Delivery Item contains the format, content and intended use information for the Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) process report resulting from the work task described in the contract. This DID should be used to compliment DI-MGMT-82144A PROGRAM PROTECTION IMPLEMENTATION PLAN which is the overarching DID for Program Protection this also includes Critical Program Information (Critical Components (CC) / Critical Program Information (CPI) / Critical Systems (CS) / Critical Technologies).

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task.

This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-82147A.

preparation_instructions.title: Format:
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor format is acceptable. The Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) portion of the PPIP will include the establishment of a SCRM program tailored to fit the contractor's acquisition program identifying how supply chain risks are addressed across the entire system lifecycle through a defense-in breadth approach to managing the risks to the integrity of information and communications technology (ICT) within covered systems.

preparation_instructions.title: Content:
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Identify SCRM countermeasures for Critical Program Information and Critical Components
Provide a list of Critical Components
Provide supplier information for all critical components
Provide assessment for any threats to critical components from suppliers
children.content: and indicate countermeasures taken to mitigate the threat(s) and assessment of security architecture, threats, and vulnerabilities, risk, and countermeasures analysis.

children.title: Provide a counterfeit prevention plan for protection of critical components
children.content: including processes to detect the occurrence, reduce the likelihood of occurrence, and mitigate the consequences of products containing counterfeit components or malicious functions

children.title: Specify assurance measures to ensure no malicious intent is designed into critical components
Describe SCRM security controls implementation per NIST SP 800-161
Objective Quality Evidence (OQE)
children.content: is any statement of fact, either quantitative or qualitative, pertaining to the quality of a product or service based on observations, measurements, or tests, which can be verified and is required in sufficient detail to describe the data elements in the Statement of Work.
